parameters.query: WITH payload AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS value), processed AS (SELECT app.process_commercial_event(value) AS result FROM payload), payment_request AS (UPDATE app.payment_requests SET status=CASE WHEN (SELECT value->>'result' FROM payload)='paid' THEN 'paid' ELSE 'failed' END,updated_at=now() WHERE onboarding_id=(SELECT NULLIF(value->>'onboarding_id','')::uuid FROM payload) RETURNING 1) SELECT result FROM processed;

parameters.jsCode: const normalized=$('Normalize Payment').item.json; const result=$('Evaluate Commercial Readiness').item.json.result??{}; const onboardingId=String(normalized.onboarding_id||result.onboarding_id||''); if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(onboardingId))throw new Error('Payment could not be correlated to an onboarding ID'); return [{json:{onboarding_id:onboardingId,request_body:JSON.stringify({onboarding_id:onboardingId})}}];
